snippet.title: Among the Waves - Official 'Awaken' Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the 'Awaken' Trailer for Among the Waves, a 2.5D cyberpunk Metroidvania game developed by VS/Studio. Players will make use of tight combat, intuitive stealth, and more to embark on a path to freedom from level to level. Step into the role of the pregnant Nameless mother to infiltrate an abandoned futuristic fortress and seek the depths of the complex in Among the Waves, coming soon to PC (Steam).

#AmongTheWaves #Adventure #Metroidvania
